CustomField.label: Engagement Link Info
CustomField.description: Read-only, clickable "Offering - SC Page Name" pointing back at the Engagement_Link__c this Opportunity came from, so the source is visible without clicking through a separate related list. Blank when Engagement_Link__c isn't set (e.g. Opportunities created outside this app).
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Engagement_Link__c), "", HYPERLINK( "/" & Engagement_Link__c, CASE(Engagement_Link__r.Offering__c, "migration-accelerator", "Migration Accelerator", Engagement_Link__r.Offering__c) & " - " & Engagement_Link__r.Name, "_self" ) )
